 Here are the Predictions for Ireland Tour of Namibia 2026 , 4th ODI Match - Namibia vs Ireland, to be played on the 30th of October at the High Performance Oval, Windhoek.
 Match Prediction - Namibia v Ireland 
 LIVE SCORES - 4th ODI Match - Namibia vs Ireland (High Performance Oval, Windhoek) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at High Performance Oval, Windhoek (ODI's) - 229
 Average 2nd Innings Total at High Performance Oval, Windhoek (ODI's) - 174
 Current Form Ireland and Namibia: 
 Namibia have won the 3rd ODI Match of the ODI Series by 63 runs to take a 2-1 lead.
 The top run scorer for Namibia in the ODI Series is Gerhard Erasmus with 232 runs to his name .
 The top wicket taker for Ireland in the ODI Series is Gavin Hoey with 7 scalps under under his belt.
 The top run scorer for Ireland in the ODI Series is Curtis Campher with 168 runs to his name .
 The top wicket taker for Namibia in the ODI Series is Jack Brassell with 7 scalps under his belt.
 In the Third ODI Match, Namibia batted first and they posted a big total of 316 for 7 in 50 overs. Louren Steenkamp got out cheaply. After his dismissal, Malan Kruger and Jan Frylinck took the responsibility of taking Namibia to a tall total. They added 48 runs for the 2nd wicket partnership. After Kruger got out, Jan Frylinck and Gerhard Erasmus got together and stitched a partnership of 102 runs for the 3rd wicket. Erasmus made 54 while Frylinck went on to score a hundred. He made 126 runs off 122 deliveries, collecting 9 fours and 4 sixes. Alexander Busing Volschenk also made an important contribution of 36 runs in 26 deliveries as Namibia managed to get to 316 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, Andy Balbirnie and Cade Carmichael both got out cheaply. Harry Tector and Lorcan Tucker also disappointed. The partnership of 61 runs for the 4th wicket between Andy McBrine and Curtis Campher lit up a little hope for the visitors. However, McBrine threw it away at a wrong time. Campher fought very hard but kept losing partners in regular succession. He scored 106 runs off 86 deliveries but failed to win the game for Ireland as they eventually fell short by a 63 runs margin.
